Liquidity events or correlated selling across asset classes could also amplify moves beyond what historical volatility alone would suggest. On the upside, a stronger-than-expected fundamental catalyst, a short squeeze, or a broad risk-on rotation could push the value above 56 more quickly than the monthly horizon implies.
